name: queens_n11__v11_nh
prompt:
Place 11 queens on a 11×11 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 11 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 10) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
